name: Super Flappy Golf
summary:
Flap your way to the green in this highly anticipated follow up to the viral Flappy Golf series!

Play vibrant and exciting courses, guiding your birdie to the hole in as few flaps as you can. Simple two-button controls designed for players of any skill level.

Challenge your friends to an action packed race to the cup. First to the hole wins! Show off your rarest birdies and make everyone jealous from the top of the podium. Take your flapping skills to the next level with new glide and dive mechanics.

Earn eggs and collect Birdie traits with different rarities to hatch stylish and sometimes crazy birdies. With millions of potential combinations you never know what you are going to get!

Features:

- 30 Exciting Courses on launch for all skill levels

- Simple two-button controls

- Play with up to 8 friends in a frantic race to the cup

- Collect and hatch eggs with different rarities

- Master the new Glide and Dive mechanics

- Try the new Lowest Flaps multiplayer mode. Precision is key

- Hundreds of Birdie traits to unlock resulting in millions of possible Birdies to hatch
